gloss: to buy more of; to top up a supply

definitions.gloss: to buy more of something one already has; to top up
definitions.explanation: To make an additional purchase because the amount on hand is not enough. Implies the item is already owned or already bought once, and the new purchase supplements it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{足|た}した。
⟦{足|た}りなければ→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{買|か}い{足|た}せば⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: If it isn't enough, we can just buy more later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧とお⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{足|た}してきます。
examples.english: Since more people are coming, I'll go buy some extra drinks and plates.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy) + ⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧ (to add). Transitive: the item bought takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive, taking ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the item added (⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{足|た}す). There is no intransitive counterpart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{足|た}す: to buy the amount that's short
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{買|か}い{足|た}す: to buy more later
- ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{買|か}い{足|た}す: to add to one's stock little by little

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}い{置|お}き→買い置き：30297_kaioki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep a stock of — buying ahead of need rather than after running short
- {買|か}い{増|ま}す: to buy more — mostly financial, as in buying more shares
- ⟦{補充|ほじゅう}する→補充する：25240_hojuusuru⟧: to replenish — more formal, often about stock or supplies at work
